cpi_data.csv.source: U.S. CPI-U (All Urban Consumers, All Items, NSA), annual averages via FRED with BLS public API fallback (superseded by dollar_year_adjustment.csv).

distributed_capacity.parquet.source: ReEDS distributed PV capacity by county (stscen2023_mid_case scenario), aggregated county -> BA and converted DC to AC (ILR 1.1) by build_new_pg_dg_inputs.py.

distributed_profiles.parquet.source: ReEDS distributed PV generation profiles (multi-year distpv-reference_ba.h5), processed by build_new_pg_dg_inputs.py.

dollar_year_adjustment.csv.source: U.S. Implicit Price Deflator for Gross Domestic Product (GDP-IPD, index 2017=100), annual, from FRED with BEA NIPA API fallback.

fuel_prices.parquet.source: EIA Annual Energy Outlook (AEO) bulk data: 'Energy Prices : Electric Power' series by census division / scenario / fuel, mapped to ReEDS Balancing Areas by .github/skills/eia-fuel-prices.

nerc_reserve_margins.csv.source: NERC Long-Term Reliability Assessment (LTRA) 'Reference Margin Level (%)' by assessment area, extracted by .github/skills/nerc-reserve-margins and carried forward through 2050.

nerc_reserve_margins_vintage.json.source: Sidecar vintage metadata (report year, source URL, retrieval timestamp) written alongside nerc_reserve_margins.csv by the NERC reserve margins extractor.

network_costs_EI_PJM.csv.source: Network / transmission cost assumptions for the EI_PJM model region. Unknown - document me.

network_costs_ReEDS.csv.source: Network / transmission cost assumptions per ReEDS region used for WECC. Unknown - document me.

operational_constraints_reeds.csv.source: ReEDS operational constraints (incl. pumped hydro duration ranges). Unknown - document me.

plant_region_map.csv.source: Plant -> region mapping built from the ReEDS generator database and PUDL/EIA yearly generators by transform_reeds_generators.py.

reeds_generators_transformed.csv.source: ReEDS generator database (ReEDS_generator_database_final_EIA-NEMS.csv) cleaned and transformed by transform_reeds_generators.py (with PUDL/EIA yearly generators for retirement info).

reeds_load_transformed.parquet.source: ReEDS hourly load HDF5 (EER_IRAlow_load_hourly.h5, LFS-backed), filtered to weather years 2007-2013 and model years 2020-2050 by transform_reeds_load.py.

regional_cost_multipliers.csv.source: EIA capital cost AEO2025 PDF tables mapped to PowerGenome technologies/regions by extract_location_variation.py.

reserve_margins.csv.source: ReEDS planning reserve margins (prm_annual.csv) joined to NERC regions via the ReEDS hierarchy by build_reserve_margins.py.

technology_costs_atb.parquet.source: NREL Annual Technology Baseline (ATB) technology cost table. Unknown - document me.

technology_heat_rates_nrelatb.csv.source: NREL Annual Technology Baseline (ATB) heat rate table. Unknown - document me.

transmission_capacity_merged.csv.source: Merged AC + non-AC transmission capacity per region pair (average of forward/reverse MW). Unknown - document me for exact upstream files.

transmission_capacity_reeds.csv.source: ReEDS AC and non-AC transmission capacity files merged by merge_transmission_capacity.py.
